title: WABAG — claimed by thegentlemen
description: IN · Energy & Utilities · wabag.in VA Tech WABAG is the world's leading pure-play water technology company, founded in 1924 and headquartered in Chennai, India, operating in over 25 countries with 2000 engineers and over 1500 plants delivered. Listed on NSE and BSE, it posted record FY2026 revenue of 3944 crore rupees with PAT of 371 crore and has been net cash positive for 6 straight years with a credit rating of AA minus
